tasks.objective: Read PS5_SEGMENT_HASH_AUDIT.json. Verify the three version counts, seven unchanged indices and 26 changed indices. Write a concise note listing the unchanged indices and explain that equal size and SHA-256 establish byte identity only within the recorded hash scope. They do not identify firmware components. Use only the supplied JSON. Do not discuss protected contents. Keep prose sentences to 25 words or fewer. Avoid semicolons and em or en dashes.

Using only PS5_ELF_INVENTORY.json and GHIDRA_ANALYSIS_STATUS.md, triage the six inventory rows whose source_container is kdata1001.bin. Verify their architecture, ELF type, executable segment counts, validated executable byte counts, entry points, full-file hashes and Ghidra function counts. Identify exact duplicates only if the available hashes prove them. State what the metadata does not establish about component identity. Recommend one bounded next metadata check. Do not open firmware binaries or publish extracted content. Keep prose sentences to 25 words or fewer. Avoid semicolons and em or en dashes.
